exposure: percentage of dietary energy intake from carbohydrates
percentage of dietary energy intake from fats
cohort: 221 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in their second trimester.
finding: Low intake of Vitamin D and iodine, low dietary carbohydrate ratio, family history of diabetes, lack of exercise, and high gestational weight gain were associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes in pregnant women with GDM.
